messages:
Aisha R.: quick sync — QA flagged that invoice/download actions are hard to find for customers when they switch to project scope. we need a clear affordance that survives narrow widths and persistent scrolling.

Josh K.: thanks. current layout: topbar with scope + timeframe, main chart, token visualization, then actions. users expect a single persistent control to grab invoices/exports.

Lena (Design): I sketched 2 directions: topbar inline button (compact) vs a slim right-side dock that houses download + export + quick filters. mock: https://redwood.design/sketches/spend-dock-vs-topbar

Marco: right-dock is great for desktop (no header bloat) but on mobile it hides behind the kebab. topbar is better for discoverability on phones.

Samir: accessibility: avoid icon-only controls without text. if dock uses icons, include offscreen text for screen readers and longpress tooltip. filename standardization: <org>[-<project>]_YYYYMMDD.pdf or .csv.

Lena (Design): updated microcopy: topbar -> "Download invoices (PDF)"; dock -> icon + label "Invoices". added aria-labels in Figma.

Aisha R.: product ask: when users change scope, the control should reflect context ("Download org invoices" vs "Download project invoices"). also track event: invoice_ui_click with scope and viewport size.

analytics-bot: suggested metrics: invoice_downloaded, csv_exported, download_cta_visible_pct, cta_click_rate_by_viewport.

Josh K.: implementation note: we can make topbar variant lightweight: single-line, left: scope selector, mid: title/summary, right: small text CTA. use position:sticky so it stays on scroll. fallback: dock only on older browsers.

Marco: experiment idea: Variant A = topbar CTA + compact numeric token row; Variant B = right dock + bubble visualization default. run 2-week experiment, measure discovery and conversion.

Samir: also test keyboard reachability for both. ensure tab order puts download CTA early.

Lena (Design): I'll push updated frames for both variants and include contrast/focus states. tagging @eng-frontend for feasibility and @research for experiment plan.

Aisha R.: timeline: aim for prototype by end of sprint. we'll decide which variant to ship after experiment. closing after mocks + RFC PR linked.
